cards.title: Elites and deep dungeons
cards.text: Every enemy can be elite with its own extra move. Three harder dungeons. Live as 0.8.0.
cards.why: Your message from today, all of it. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details:
Batches: with every node bought, all six dungeons are won; with only tier I bought, almost nothing is won now (extra waves, steeper floors, elites). That's steep; say if the start should be gentler.

The deep three use the enemy art you said wasn't good, as placeholders.

parts.title: Elites
parts.text: Any enemy can be elite: 2.4x health, 1.8x damage, 1.5x faster, a bit bigger, less gold, a gold rim. Each kind has its own extra move: the elite slime lobs slimelets and dies into four slimes that split again; rats leave plague gas; archers loose five-arrow volleys; brutes shield-bash; ghosts blink behind you; trolls throw boulders; and so on. About 5% of enemies on floor 1, rising with floor, dungeon and wave.

parts.title: Three deep dungeons
parts.text: After the Crypt: the Frost Hollow (bats, snowmen, spiders, banshee, ogre; webs), the Ember Deep (imps, fire slimes, devils, demons, dragonborn; burning ground) and the Gilded Spire (cherubs, angels, seraphs; sigils that call down light). Each has a warden and a boss (powered-up wardens for now).

parts.title: Scaling
parts.text: Upgrades are stronger (Might +14% a rank, Vigor +16%, Haste +9%, each tier past I cuts that ability's cooldown 10%), and dungeons and floors get much harder to match.

parts.title: Waves and pace
parts.text: 3 to 4 more waves per room, each about 16% bigger with more elites. Everyone moves 20% slower than 0.7.

parts.title: Door exit
parts.text: A hero near the chosen door steps into a shaft of light, lifts, glows, shrinks and is gone; the room ends as soon as all are through.

parts.title: Found trinkets
parts.text: Found trinkets pop out as a violet gem; a hero with room walks over and takes it, a full hero leaves it for an ally. I read 'an additional trinket' as one more than the hero's slots while in a dungeon.

parts.title: Grid obstacles
parts.text: Rooms are laid on a grid: walls are straight runs of cells, crates, barrels, boulders and braziers take one cell each, in small clumps, and spikes are one cell across.

cards.title: Polish and the new camp
cards.text: Merged shadows, death bursts, faint bodies, purple summons, HP and XP numbers, and a camp and skill tree laid out anew.
cards.why: The camp and tree are real layout changes this time, in Night watch. Two of each, switchable in settings.

parts.title: Shadows and deaths
parts.text: Shadows are smaller and merge where they overlap instead of stacking darker. Anything that dies bursts (a pop, a ring, puffs in its colour); bodies grey out and lie faint.

parts.title: Summons
parts.text: Raised skeletons were using the old skeleton art: now they use the current one with a purple outline, as does every summon (the wolf had no art; it uses the tamer's wolf for now).

parts.title: Hero cards
parts.text: HP and XP each have a bar with its numbers again.

parts.title: Camp layouts
parts.text: The clearing (default): your party round the fire, the tent for heroes, the trader's cart, the book on a stump, sellswords by a lantern, a signpost to the dungeons. Fireside: a side-on view with a bench of heroes and the dungeons as gates in the mountains.

parts.title: Skill tree layouts
parts.text: Grove (default): a tree growing up out of the hero, one bough per ability, tiers on level bands, training as roots. Star wheel: the hero at the hub, rings per level, the branch you tap turns to the top.
